subbench.objective: A CENSUS across the PCRE syntax an engine may support, one construct per pattern in an otherwise plain body, seeded from pcrec's `--list-syntax` construct registry so nothing is enumerated from either side's head: what each construct COSTS to compile and to run, on the same subjects and the same instrument as every other set, so that a testee's outlier on one family points at ONE mechanism -- and what a refusal, a compile-time cliff or an engine-selection surprise on a construct the registry calls built looks like. The census widens the queue of depth probes; it does not shorten it (inbox I-42, Frank's charter).

testee.build_flags: distribution libpcre2-8.so.0 (10.46 2025-08-27), loaded with dlopen; driver built with $CC -O2 -std=gnu11
testee.compile_cost_definition: eager JIT (requirements 3): the explicit compile calls, timed in-driver -- pcre2_compile_8 (`compile`) then pcre2_jit_compile_8(PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE) (`jit-compile`). Median of N with spread is the REPORTER's reduction.

capturecount.description: lexical capturing groups in the pattern

compiled_size_bytes.description: size of the compiled pattern block -- requirements 4.2's 'program size' for this engine

jit_size_bytes.description: size of the JIT-compiled machine code; absent on the interpreter testee (an ABSENT pair is not an error, an UNDECLARED one is)
